ledger.summary: Ralph rides with Roger on a red roan war-horse; Roger rides a grey. Ralph accuses Roger of lies; Roger admits some but says another, unnamed, wishes Ralph well because of his two sword-strokes, and Ralph hopes it means the lady. They ride over four hours through beech wood to a stony waste of low hills, rest, and Roger promises a noble house of his master, far away, to be reached before morning.
ledger.geography_notes: From the wood south of the Burg: beech wood clear of undergrowth for four hours or more, then a waste of little low stony hills with scraggy thorns and bird-sown berry trees and poor grazing.
